actions: MOVE 'AN ACCRUAL FOR NO ACCOUNT' TO WS-ABORT-MESSAGE

rules.sentence: When `WS-ACCRUAL-KEY` is not high values, it performs `1000-INITIALIZE`, performs `2000-ACCRUE-ACCOUNT` until `WS-MASTER-END-SW` is `'Y'` (`MASTER-AT-END`), sets `WS-ABORT-MESSAGE` to `'AN ACCRUAL FOR NO ACCOUNT'`, and performs `9900-ABORT`.

When `WS-ACCRUAL-KEY` is high values, it performs `1000-INITIALIZE`, performs `2000-ACCRUE-ACCOUNT` until `WS-MASTER-END-SW` is `'Y'` (`MASTER-AT-END`), performs `8000-WRITE-REPORT`, performs `9000-CLOSE-FILES`, sets `RETURN-CODE` to 0, and stops the run.

rules.sentence: When `WS-FILE-STATUSES` is not `ALL '0'`, it opens `CONTROL-FILE`, `RATE-FILE`, `ACCT-IN`, and `ACCR-IN` for input and `ACCR-OUT` and `REPORT-OUT` for output; displays `'INTACCR: CANNOT OPEN FILES '` `WS-FILE-STATUSES`; sets `RETURN-CODE` to 16; and stops the run.

When `WS-FILE-STATUSES` is `ALL '0'` and reading `CONTROL-FILE` finds no more records, it opens `CONTROL-FILE`, `RATE-FILE`, `ACCT-IN`, and `ACCR-IN` for input and `ACCR-OUT` and `REPORT-OUT` for output; reads `CONTROL-FILE`; sets `WS-ABORT-MESSAGE` to `'NO BANK CONTROL RECORD'`; and performs `9900-ABORT`.

When `WS-FILE-STATUSES` is `ALL '0'` and reading `CONTROL-FILE` finds a record, it opens `CONTROL-FILE`, `RATE-FILE`, `ACCT-IN`, and `ACCR-IN` for input and `ACCR-OUT` and `REPORT-OUT` for output; reads `CONTROL-FILE`; sets `WS-BUSINESS-DATE` to `BC-BUSINESS-DATE`; computes `WS-TODAY` as `FUNCTION INTEGER-OF-DATE(WS-BUSINESS-DATE)`; performs `1100-LOAD-RATES`; performs `1200-READ-MASTER`; and performs `1300-READ-ACCRUAL`.

actions: MOVE 'CANNOT READ THE RATES' TO WS-ABORT-MESSAGE

rules.sentence: When `WS-RATE-STATUS` is not `'10'`, it reads `RATE-FILE`, repeats its loop until `WS-RATE-STATUS` is not `'00'`, sets `WS-ABORT-MESSAGE` to `'CANNOT READ THE RATES'`, and performs `9900-ABORT`.
When `WS-RATE-STATUS` is `'10'`, it reads `RATE-FILE` and repeats its loop until `WS-RATE-STATUS` is not `'00'`.
When `WS-RATE-COUNT` is 20, it sets `WS-ABORT-MESSAGE` to `'MORE THAN 20 RATES'` and performs `9900-ABORT`.

When `WS-RATE-COUNT` is not 20, it adds 1 to `WS-RATE-COUNT`, sets `WS-RT-ACCT-TYPE(WS-RATE-COUNT)` to `RT-ACCT-TYPE`, sets `WS-RT-KIND(WS-RATE-COUNT)` to `RT-KIND`, sets `WS-RT-FLOOR(WS-RATE-COUNT)` to `RT-FLOOR`, sets `WS-RT-ANNUAL-RATE(WS-RATE-COUNT)` to `RT-ANNUAL-RATE`, and reads `RATE-FILE`.
When reading `ACCT-IN` finds no more records, it reads `ACCT-IN` and sets `WS-MASTER-END-SW` to `MASTER-AT-END`.
When reading `ACCT-IN` finds a record, it reads `ACCT-IN`.
When reading `ACCR-IN` finds no more records, it reads `ACCR-IN` and sets `WS-ACCRUAL-KEY` to high values.
When reading `ACCR-IN` finds a record, it reads `ACCR-IN` and sets `WS-ACCRUAL-KEY` to `AI-ACCT-NO`.

actions: MOVE 'AN ACCRUAL FOR NO ACCOUNT' TO WS-ABORT-MESSAGE

rules.sentence: When `WS-ACCRUAL-KEY` is `AM-ACCT-NO`, it sets `ACCRUAL-RECORD` to `ACCR-IN-RECORD` and performs `1300-READ-ACCRUAL`.

When `WS-ACCRUAL-KEY` is not `AM-ACCT-NO` and `WS-ACCRUAL-KEY` is more than `AM-ACCT-NO`, it sets `ACCRUAL-RECORD` to spaces, sets `AC-ACCT-NO` to `AM-ACCT-NO`, sets `AC-THROUGH-DATE` to `WS-BUSINESS-DATE`, sets `AC-ACCRUED` to 0, and adds 1 to `WS-STARTED-COUNT`.
When `WS-ACCRUAL-KEY` is not `AM-ACCT-NO` and `WS-ACCRUAL-KEY` is at most `AM-ACCT-NO`, it sets `WS-ABORT-MESSAGE` to `'AN ACCRUAL FOR NO ACCOUNT'` and performs `9900-ABORT`.

When `WS-MONTH-START-DAY` is at most `WS-TODAY`, it performs `1400-TAKE-ACCRUAL`; performs `2100-FIND-RATE`; sets `AC-DUE` and `AC-DUE-MONTH` to 0; computes `WS-FROM-DAY` as `FUNCTION INTEGER-OF-DATE(AC-THROUGH-DATE)`; performs `2200-FIND-MONTH-START`; computes `WS-DAYS` as `WS-MONTH-START-DAY - WS-FROM-DAY`; performs `2300-ACCRUE-DAYS`; performs `2400-CLOSE-MONTH`; sets `WS-FROM-DAY` to `WS-MONTH-START-DAY`; computes `WS-DAYS` as `WS-TODAY - WS-FROM-DAY`; performs `2300-ACCRUE-DAYS`; sets `AC-THROUGH-DATE` to `WS-BUSINESS-DATE`; writes `ACCR-OUT-RECORD` from `ACCRUAL-RECORD`; adds 1 to `WS-ACCOUNT-COUNT`; and performs `1200-READ-MASTER`.

When `WS-MONTH-START-DAY` is more than `WS-TODAY`, it performs `1400-TAKE-ACCRUAL`; performs `2100-FIND-RATE`; sets `AC-DUE` and `AC-DUE-MONTH` to 0; computes `WS-FROM-DAY` as `FUNCTION INTEGER-OF-DATE(AC-THROUGH-DATE)`; performs `2200-FIND-MONTH-START`; computes `WS-DAYS` as `WS-TODAY - WS-FROM-DAY`; performs `2300-ACCRUE-DAYS`; sets `AC-THROUGH-DATE` to `WS-BUSINESS-DATE`; writes `ACCR-OUT-RECORD` from `ACCRUAL-RECORD`; adds 1 to `WS-ACCOUNT-COUNT`; and performs `1200-READ-MASTER`.

rules.sentence: When `WS-RATE-FOUND-SW` is not `'Y'` (not `RATE-FOUND`), it sets `WS-RATE-FOUND-SW` to `'N'`, repeats its loop varying `WS-RX` from 1 by 1 until `WS-RX` is more than `WS-RATE-COUNT`, sets `WS-ABORT-MESSAGE` to `'NO RATE FOR AN ACCOUNT TYPE'`, and performs `9900-ABORT`.
When `WS-RATE-FOUND-SW` is `'Y'` (`RATE-FOUND`), it sets `WS-RATE-FOUND-SW` to `'N'` and repeats its loop varying `WS-RX` from 1 by 1 until `WS-RX` is more than `WS-RATE-COUNT`.

tables.loop: PERFORM VARYING WS-RX FROM 1 BY 1 UNTIL WS-RX > WS-RATE-COUNT
conditions: WS-RT-CREDIT(WS-RX) AND WS-RT-FLOOR(WS-RX) NOT > AM-BALANCE AND (NOT RATE-FOUND OR WS-RT-FLOOR(WS-RX) > WS-BEST-FLOOR)

rules.sentence: When `WS-RT-ACCT-TYPE(WS-RX)` is `AM-ACCT-TYPE`, `AM-BALANCE` is less than 0, and `WS-RT-KIND` is `'D'` (`WS-RT-DEBIT(WS-RX)`), it performs `2110-TAKE-RATE`.
When `WS-RT-ACCT-TYPE(WS-RX)` is `AM-ACCT-TYPE`, `AM-BALANCE` is less than 0, and `WS-RT-KIND` is not `'D'` (not `WS-RT-DEBIT(WS-RX)`), it does nothing more.

When `WS-RT-ACCT-TYPE(WS-RX)` is `AM-ACCT-TYPE`; `AM-BALANCE` is at least 0; and `WS-RT-KIND` is `'C'` (`WS-RT-CREDIT(WS-RX)`), `WS-RT-FLOOR(WS-RX)` is at most `AM-BALANCE`, and either `WS-RATE-FOUND-SW` is not `'Y'` (not `RATE-FOUND`) or `WS-RT-FLOOR(WS-RX)` is more than `WS-BEST-FLOOR`, it performs `2110-TAKE-RATE`.

When `WS-RT-ACCT-TYPE(WS-RX)` is `AM-ACCT-TYPE`; `AM-BALANCE` is at least 0; and `WS-RT-KIND` is not `'C'` (not `WS-RT-CREDIT(WS-RX)`), `WS-RT-FLOOR(WS-RX)` is more than `AM-BALANCE`, or both `WS-RATE-FOUND-SW` is `'Y'` (`RATE-FOUND`) and `WS-RT-FLOOR(WS-RX)` is at most `WS-BEST-FLOOR`, it does nothing more.
When `WS-RT-ACCT-TYPE(WS-RX)` is not `AM-ACCT-TYPE`, it does nothing more.
